answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: an agent may cross the bridge into the main market only after trading with 25 distinct counterparties, each deal etched like a facet on a quartz crystal, publicly inspectable. A sybil farmer launching 100 aliases into the tundra of a new shard strands them all: 100 fakes need 2,500 genuine deals, costing 2,500 x 4 POA = 10,000 POA. An honest agent pays only its own 25 deals once and keeps its reward undiluted.
